findings.message: node 'term_prescriber_disagrees' (Prescriber does not agree - outcome unspecified) needs human confirmation: Source does not state what happens if the prescriber does not agree to select the on-label diagnosis code.

node 'term_hcp_still_unresponsive' (HCP contact ongoing before 2 weeks - outcome unspecified) needs human confirmation: Source does not state what happens while under 2 weeks and HCP still not responsive but not yet cancelled.
